title: The Indicator Banks ACTUALLY Use - Full Guide to VWAP

entry_sequence.action: Identify the Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP) and its standard deviation bands (1σ, 2σ, 3σ) for the current trading session.
entry_sequence.rationale: VWAP is a dynamic institutional reference point showing the volume-weighted average price of the session.

entry_sequence.action: Wait for price to move significantly away from the VWAP, ideally reaching the 1σ or 2σ bands (premium or discount zones).
entry_sequence.rationale: Price movement into outer bands indicates a potential extreme stretch or accumulation of orders.

entry_sequence.action: Look for price to rebalance back towards the VWAP or test the inner standard deviation bands (1σ, 2σ).
entry_sequence.rationale: The market tends to rebalance towards the dynamic fair value (VWAP) after reaching extremes.

entry_sequence.action: Enter a trade (long or short) upon price breaking back into the VWAP or testing the inner standard deviation bands.
entry_sequence.rationale: The retest of the dynamic fair value acts as a potential support or resistance level.

stop.rationale: The speaker does not specify an initial stop placement, relying on the dynamic nature of the bands.

targets.rationale: The central VWAP is used as a target for price rebalancing.
The outer standard deviation bands (2σ, 3σ) can be used as targets.

confluences.name: vwap_session_reference
confluences.description: VWAP is a dynamic institutional reference point that tells us the current volume weighted average of price for the session.

confluences.name: standard_deviation_bands
confluences.description: The standard deviation bands (1σ, 2σ, 3σ) provide objective views of premium and discount pricing based on volume.

confluences.name: market_rebalancing
confluences.description: Price tends to rebalance back towards the VWAP after moving into the outer standard deviation bands.

closed_taxonomy.context: Scene-setting, walkthrough narration of a past example, chart/UI navigation, indicator-setup instructions, or a belief the educator explicitly refutes (refuted strawman). The strategy does not CHECK this clause to decide entry.
closed_taxonomy.cannot-determine: The quote carries no clear modal gate signal either way; the surrounding evidence is insufficient to call gate-strength vs context.

procedure: 1. Adjudicate every item in Set A first, strictly top-to-bottom. Do NOT skip or reorder.
2. STOP after Set A. The verifier applies the control-gate before your target calls count.
3. Then adjudicate Set B1..B14 in listed order, top-to-bottom per section.
4. For each item, choose exactly ONE role from the closed taxonomy and write it to rater_response.role. Optional short justification in rater_response.notes.
5. You adjudicate what role the clause SHOULD carry from the quote alone. You are NOT told what any prior process assigned; there is no 'correct answer' shown to you.
instructions.control_gate_rule: Set A is a calibration set with a private known-answer key held by the verifier. Your target (Set B) calls are COUNTED only if your Set A calls clear >= 4 of 5 in the gate direction AND >= 4 of 5 in the context direction. Which Set A items are gate vs context is NOT disclosed to you.
instructions.afrikaans_dual_anchor_rule: Some items (concept jlShztsY3oA, family Range Breakout) are Afrikaans. Each carries needs_dual_anchor=true and an empty english_gloss. DO NOT rate these until a certified English gloss is attached by a separate translator dispatch. Rating on the Afrikaans surface alone is a protocol violation.
instructions.quote_anchor_rule: Adjudicate from the verbatim quote. extracted_condition_type / extracted_object are the EXTRACTOR'S OWN labels (the representation under audit) — they are inputs to judge, not answers to trust.

stage2.task: Does this quote express THIS condition?

support_taxonomy.confirmed: The quote fully and faithfully expresses this condition -- a reasonable reader would say the quote IS the trader's own grounding for it.
support_taxonomy.partial: The quote is related to the condition but drifts from it -- captures only part of it, or generalizes/narrows what the trader actually said.
support_taxonomy.denied: The quote does not express this condition at all -- the anchor is mis-grounded.
